title: Remaining Value and the Extension-Fee Basis — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
**Accounting rule.** The extension-fee basis of a credit of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers is set from the credit's remaining value. For the extension fee, the remaining value is the value the credit's ledger shows: loads, reversals and restores, less redemptions, forfeited remainders, expiry write-offs and refund payouts.

- remaining value **below 150 US dollars**: the basis is 40 percent of the remaining value;
- remaining value **at least 150 but below 400 US dollars**: the basis is the lesser of the instrument's extension fee and 30 percent of the remaining value;
- remaining value **400 US dollars or more**: the basis is the instrument's extension fee.

## Remaining value from the ledger (hypothetical)

| Ledger entries | Amount (USD) |
|---|---|
| load | 500.00 |
| redemption | 180.00 taken off |
| reversal | 60.00 added |
| remaining value | 380.00 |

## Bands on both sides (hypothetical instrument whose extension fee is 99 US dollars)

| Remaining value | Working | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| 120.00 | 40 percent of 120.00 | 48.00 |
| 150.00 | lesser of 99.00 and 30 percent of 150.00, which is 45.00 | 45.00 |
| 300.00 | lesser of 99.00 and 30 percent of 300.00, which is 90.00 | 90.00 |
| 380.00 | lesser of 99.00 and 30 percent of 380.00, which is 114.00 | 99.00 |
| 400.00 | the instrument's extension fee | 99.00 |
